subject: Pudding King
fact: Pudding King reveals his transformation into a sentient ooze, telepathically screaming his intentions: 'I have shed my humanoid form for the supreme power! I shall reduce all of deep known kind into nothing but ooze!'
source_quote: I have shed my humanoid form for the supreme power! I shall reduce all of deep known kind into nothing but ooze!

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir grapples the Pudding King in ooze form and drags him into Glabbagool, prompting the gelatinous cube to say 'this tickles'
source_quote: this tickles

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool (in Pudding King's body) cries out: 'Why are you hurting me?'
source_quote: Why are you hurting me?

subject: Pudding King
fact: Pudding King delivers his final telepathic scream: 'Behold the true feast, the soul's final blend!' before dissolving completely
source_quote: Behold the true feast, the soul's final blend!

subject: throne room
fact: The throne room contains green slime hanging from the ceiling ready to drop on anyone who passes beneath it
source_quote: green slime hanging from the ceiling ready to drop on anyone who passes beneath it

subject: Bag of Holding
fact: The party discusses using their Bag of Holding to contain the ooze, realizing a sentient ooze could ooze back out through the opening
source_quote: Bag of Holding

subject: Spellbook
fact: The party discovers a spellbook containing numerous magical formulas that had been consumed by Princess Ebonmire
source_quote: spellbook containing numerous magical formulas that had been consumed by Princess Ebonmire

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Thorin strikes with his radiant sword Dawnbringer, its holy light searing through the corrupted ooze
source_quote: Dawnbringer

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool, the gelatinous cube companion, remarks 'this tickles' when the Pudding King is dragged through him
source_quote: this tickles

subject: Pudding King
fact: Pudding King is a sentient, telepathic ooze—a manifestation of his complete embrace of Juiblex, the demon lord of oozes
source_quote: sentient, telepathic ooze—a manifestation of his complete embrace of Juiblex, the demon lord of oozes

subject: Green Slime
fact: Green slime hangs from the ceiling of the throne room, ready to drop on anyone who passes beneath it
source_quote: green slime hanging from the ceiling, ready to drop on anyone who passes beneath it

subject: Prince Livid
fact: Prince Livid, one of the ooze king's allies, retaliates with psychic blasts
source_quote: Prince Livid, one of the ooze king's allies, retaliates with psychic blasts

subject: Princess Ebonmire
fact: Princess Ebonmire hurles blobs of acidic ooze at the party and is later destroyed by necrotic magic and physical strikes
source_quote: Princess Ebonmire hurles blobs of acidic ooze at the party

subject: Underdark
fact: The Pudding King intends to reduce all of the Underdark into nothing but ooze
source_quote: reduce all of the Underdark into nothing but ooze

subject: throne room
fact: The Pudding King’s lair actions give him additional power within his domain
source_quote: lair actions give him additional power within his domain

subject: cave
fact: Glabbagool and the Pudding King first met in a cave, confirming their body swap
source_quote: they had met in a cave

subject: cavern
fact: Fungi growing throughout the cavern become more twisted and malevolent, suggesting Zuggtmoy is filling the power vacuum
source_quote: fungi growing throughout the cavern were becoming more twisted and malevolent in appearance

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool, now an Ooze, suggests the party carry him in a jar or Bag of Holding to travel with them as the ultimate garbage disposal
source_quote: carry him in a jar or even in their Bag of Holding, allowing him to travel with them and see the world while serving as the ultimate garbage disposal

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir takes a mental note to suggest Glabbagool begin training to become a monk, to control his form with precision
source_quote: take a mental note to suggest that Glabbagool begin the training to become a monk

subject: Juiblex
fact: A demonic voice echoes through the chamber, possibly Juiblex himself, declaring that he would be reborn and consume the banquet of the queen of fungi to grow even stronger
source_quote: he would be reborn and consume the banquet of the queen of fungi to grow even stronger

subject: Zuggtmoy
fact: Zuggtmoy, the demon queen of fungi, is moving to fill the power vacuum left by the Pudding King's defeat
source_quote: Zuggtmoy, the demon queen of fungi, was already moving to fill the power vacuum left by the Pudding King's defeat

subject: body swap
fact: Glabbagool and the Pudding King swap bodies, confirmed when Glabbagool speaks from the Pudding King's form and asks 'Why are you hurting me?'
source_quote: Why are you hurting me?

subject: dissolution
fact: The Pudding King dissolves completely, his consciousness dissipating as his physical form melted into inert puddles
source_quote: the Pudding King dissolved completely, his consciousness dissipating as his physical form melted into inert puddles

subject: escape
fact: The party secures a way out of the Underdark, earning their ticket to escape the endless darkness beneath the world
source_quote: securing a way out of the Underdark

subject: demonic retreat
fact: The toxic, oppressive presence of Juiblex's demonic power begins to recede from the stones and air, seeping away like water draining from a basin
source_quote: The toxic, oppressive presence of Juiblex's demonic power began to recede from the stones and air, seeping away like water draining from a basin

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool is a gelatinous cube companion who remarks 'this tickles' when the Pudding King is dragged through him
source_quote: this tickles

subject: throne room
fact: The throne room is the site of the final battle, where the Pudding King is dragged out and loses his lair advantage
source_quote: dragged out of the throne room entirely
